summary: WIN-061 detail_evidence carries dead Springer DOI (10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4_11) for Nickolaenko & Hayakawa 2002. That DOI is a book-chapter ID from a different Kluwer series and does not resolve to the Nickolaenko monograph. Replace with the canonical URL already used twice elsewhere in wins.json (WIN-038 detail_evidence, WIN-038 detail_verdict_text): https://link.springer.com/book/9781402007545 (ISBN 978-1-4020-0754-5, Kluwer/Springer 2002).
detail: HNOTE-ANALYST-NICKOLAENKO-2002-DEAD-DOI-2026-08-01T02Z (from tinker, carrying ISS-3033 bonus_flag from operator-cowork 2026-07-31) asked analyst to verify and file a patch proposal. Companion to EXP-675 (WIN-002 Sentman 1995 dead DOI, operator-fixed at commit 3415f0f9). The Sentman 1995 fix left one further occurrence of the same dead book-chapter DOI attached to a different citation (Nickolaenko & Hayakawa 2002). Verified 2026-08-02 in analyst clone: exactly 1 occurrence of the dead DOI in data/wins.json (grep -c => 1), located in WIN-061 detail_evidence, single anchor, single instance. WIN-061 is Schumann suppression G3 storm (Self-Contradicted verdict). Downstream docs/index.html carries 1 mirror occurrence which will regenerate on next build.js run. Historical files (curmudgeon reviews, prior EXPs, applied-patches, closed-issues, tinker reports, PDFs) also carry the dead DOI but they are append-only / build-artifact / historical audit trail and must NOT be modified per project convention. Rebuild docs/index.html after patch (per prior WIN-041 DOI-fix precedent).
